findings.title: Bundled theme catalog is duplicated across Redux state and package constants
findings.why_it_matters: Static catalog data should have one authority; duplicating it across runtime state and package constants widens the state surface without leverage.
findings.what_is_wrong: Pre-loop-3 ThemeState stored availableThemes, persistence serialized it, and runtime readers still bypassed Redux through BUNDLED_THEMES and findThemeById.
evidence: packages/state/src/selectors.ts (pre-loop-3) exported selectAvailableThemes/selectCurrentTheme from Redux state
findings.leverage_impact: Callers had to learn which authority to trust for the same bundled catalog.
findings.locality_impact: Theme catalog changes spread through slice state, selectors, persistence, and UI readers.
findings.why_weakens_submission: Redux appeared to own bundled theme data that it did not actually control.
findings.minimal_correction_path: Keep only selectedThemeId in Redux, derive the bundled catalog from @tiercade/theme, and persist only the selected ID.

simplification_check.structurally_necessary: Removes false Redux ownership over bundled theme data and passes the deletion test for the extra slice field.
simplification_check.helpful_simplification: The state package now owns only the mutable choice: selectedThemeId.
simplification_check.should_not_be_done: Do not add a theme repository or another adapter layer.
simplification_check.tests_after_fix: Selector tests assert the bundled catalog/current theme interface directly; persistence test asserts only selectedThemeId is serialized.

backlog.title: Re-score after collapsing duplicated theme authority
backlog.why_it_matters: The refactor resolved the only fresh finding; the next critic pass determines whether the branch returns to contest-grade scores.
backlog.score_impact: architecture_quality + state_management + data_flow + simplicity + credibility back to 9.5

builder_notes.how_to_recognize: Reducers only mutate the selected ID, but the slice also carries the full bundled catalog.
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Keep immutable bundled data in the package that defines it; keep only mutable choices in Redux.

builder_notes.how_to_recognize: Persisted JSON grows even though restore logic could recompute the data from code constants.
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Persist only user choices and runtime state, not immutable bundled fixtures.

builder_notes.how_to_recognize: Callers need the same selector contract, but the authority behind it can move to a better source.
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Preserve the interface; simplify the ownership behind it.

findings.title: onboardingSlice reducer-body localStorage I/O
findings.why_it_matters: Redux reducers must be pure functions. localStorage I/O in reducer bodies breaks time-travel debugging, server rendering, and test isolation. It also pulls ownership out of the established persistence seam.
findings.what_is_wrong: loadInitialState() called at module load (ambient dependency); completeOnboarding, skipOnboarding, resetOnboarding reducers called localStorage.setItem/removeItem directly.
evidence: packages/state/src/onboardingSlice.ts:24 — loadInitialState() localStorage.getItem at module load
findings.why_weakens_submission: Demonstrates misunderstanding of Redux invariants; undermines trust in other reducers
findings.minimal_correction_path: Remove loadInitialState(), STORAGE_KEY, all localStorage.* from reducer bodies; extend createPersistenceMiddleware persistedState to include onboarding key

findings.title: dynamic require() for vote; unused clearDeferredPairs import
findings.why_it_matters: require() inside an ESM module with top-level imports is a mixing of module systems; it bypasses tree-shaking and signals either a workaround for a circular dependency or inattention. Unused imports are noise.
findings.what_is_wrong: require('@tiercade/core') called inside thunk body at runtime rather than using the static import already at top. clearDeferredPairs imported but never referenced.
evidence: packages/state/src/headToHeadThunks.ts:17 — clearDeferredPairs imported but never used
findings.why_weakens_submission: Signals module-system confusion; adds noise to import graph
findings.minimal_correction_path: Remove dynamic require(); use already-present static import. Remove unused clearDeferredPairs import.

findings.title: Item allows impossible multi-URL combinations
findings.why_it_matters: If an Item can simultaneously have imageUrl, videoUrl, audioUrl, and mediaType set, reader sites must branch defensively and test coverage cannot prove impossible states are excluded. A discriminated union makes impossible states unrepresentable at compile time.
findings.what_is_wrong: Item interface exposed imageUrl?, videoUrl?, audioUrl?, mediaType? as independent optional fields alongside an ItemMedia discriminated union — allowing any combination.
evidence: packages/core/src/models.ts:17-28 — four independent URL fields on Item
filtering.ts:getItemMediaType — 10-line switch/case checking each field independently
apps/web/src/hooks/useItemForm.ts — three-branch if/else checking videoUrl, audioUrl, imageUrl separately
apps/web/src/hooks/useItemInteraction.ts — triple-clear pattern (item.videoUrl=undefined, item.audioUrl=undefined) before setting new URL
findings.metric_signal: impossible state representable; defensive branching at every read site
findings.why_weakens_submission: Type system not carrying its weight; each new reader must re-derive which fields are set
findings.minimal_correction_path: Replace four parallel fields with media?: ItemMedia; update all 18 reader/writer sites mechanically
findings.blast_radius: packages/core/src/models.ts, packages/core/src/filtering.ts, packages/core/src/modelResolver.ts, packages/ui/src/tier-board/TierRow.tsx, packages/ui/src/tier-board/TierBoard.tsx, packages/ui/src/components/StreamingOverlay.tsx, apps/web/src/hooks/useItemForm.ts, apps/web/src/hooks/useItemInteraction.ts, apps/web/src/components/ItemModal.tsx, apps/web/src/hooks/useExportHandlers.ts, apps/web/src/utils/urlSharing.ts, apps/web/src/pages/HeadToHeadPage.tsx, plus 6 test files

simplification_check.structurally_necessary: F-003 fix is net deletion: 4 fields removed from Item, ~40 lines removed across reader sites. Passes deletion test — every removed line was conditional branching required only because impossible states were possible.
simplification_check.new_seam_justified: No new seam created. ItemMedia union already existed in models.ts; fix moves it from documentation-only to enforced.
simplification_check.helpful_simplification: createItem 12→6 lines. getItemMediaType 10→1 line. itemHasMedia 3→1 line. onFileDrop 8→3 lines. onItemMediaDrop eliminated triple-clear pattern. All subtractive.
simplification_check.should_not_do: Do not add a separate ItemMediaValidator class. Do not make Item a class. Do not add runtime validation middleware for ItemMedia.

builder_notes: Discriminated union at the type level is the correct tool for mutually exclusive variants. If a field combination is impossible, the type must make it impossible — not comments or factory policy.
Reducer body I/O smell: any localStorage.*, fetch(), setTimeout() inside createSlice.reducers.* body must move to middleware or thunks.
Dynamic require() inside ESM: always use top-level static import instead.
loops.narrative: Strong contender. The H2H algorithm (Wilson-score CI, warm-start pairings), injectable-storage middleware, and memoized selector graph were the structural anchors from the start. Loop 1 eliminated the two execution-correctness findings (reducer-body I/O, dynamic require()). Loop 2 closed the domain-modeling gap: impossible multi-URL Item state is now unrepresentable at the type level, and every reader site became simpler as a result. All 9 dimensions at 9.5. No open findings. HALT_SUCCESS.

loop_result.what_changed: Replaced Item.imageUrl/videoUrl/audioUrl/mediaType (4 parallel optional fields) with Item.media?: ItemMedia discriminated union (F-003 resolved). Updated all 18 reader/writer sites including 12 source files and 6 test files.
loop_result.evidence_change_is_honest: 239/239 tests pass post-loop-2 (0 failures, 0 skips). net deletion: ~40 lines removed, ~25 lines added (simplified reader sites). TypeScript strict mode: no new type assertions except one safe cast in ItemModal.tsx form string. Old parallel URL fields fully absent from codebase.

Honesty check: 239/239 tests pass; no test assertions on old fields; new assertions on media?.type and media?.url. Regression check: no pre-existing test broke; no new skips or xfails introduced.
